notes: DIGITUS is the ASSMANN Electronic GmbH (Germany) brand (digitus.com / products.digitus.com). Its IP-camera lines are discontinued and no longer sold: the PlugView line (DN-160xx) was a cloud/app-based P2P system (Cervis platform) with no documented direct RTSP URL, and the standalone ONVIF R-Opti* cameras (R-OptiMax DN-16037, R-OptiView DN-16028, R-OptiVision DN-16027, R-OptiArc DN-16036, DN-16026) had user manuals hosted on ftp.assmann.com (e.g. ftp.assmann.com/pub/DN-/DN-16037___4016032324379/DN-16037_manual_manual english_20130531.pdf) that are now 404 and were not captured by the Wayback Machine (only the product pages/datasheets were). The current DIGITUS/Assmann shop no longer lists cameras and digitus.com/en/support/downloads and the digitus-data/handbuecher paths return 404. With no manufacturer manual retrievable to confirm the path, status is unverified. Default RTSP port assumed 554 but not officially documented.
